flows.title: Live tactical gate (L015) — continuous updates, latency, identity, dropout

assertions.name: the live transport really serves the L002 scenario sessions (no fixture: the transport's own listing)
assertions.evidence: listing: 8 sources (kind=story/tactical/tactical/tactical/tactical/tactical/tactical/tactical); normal="Synthetic live tracking — normal delivery"; reconnect="Synthetic live tracking — reconnect"; drop="Synthetic live tracking — scattered drops"

assertions.name: the source is honestly labeled the L002 deterministic synthetic tracking source
assertions.evidence: sourceNote="L002 deterministic synthetic tracking source — scenario 'normal', 600 ticks @ 100ms (every tick delivered in order at the base latency)"

assertions.name: the live tactical surface is LIVE in the real browser with a rendered canvas
assertions.evidence: data-live-phase=live; canvas count=1; label="Live tactical pitch: world version 98, 24 entities at event time 10s"

assertions.name: the probe observed the real stream (the page's own EventSource traffic, no dev API)
assertions.evidence: probe opens=1; captured world frames=16 (16 on the normal session)

assertions.name: the session under test IS the transport's listed normal session (no hidden session)
assertions.evidence: captured sessionIds={sess-4}; under test=sess-4

assertions.name: state updates arrive continuously (measured receipt cadence matches the declared cadence)
assertions.evidence: n=15 intervals; median=500ms (min 499, max 503) vs declared 500ms; tolerance ±45%; frames=16

assertions.name: the rendered tactical state visibly follows state changes (DOM world versions advance with the frames)
assertions.evidence: polled DOM world versions=[98, 100, 101, 103, 104, 106]; captured at window start=v98, at polls=v106; distinct=6

assertions.name: meaningful state changes arrive (ball and player move beyond the threshold between frames)
assertions.evidence: ball: max=3.75m mean=3.118m (n=15); player p-home-01: max=0.47m mean=0.255m

assertions.name: the latency measurement produced a real percentile window (never an absent metric claimed as met)
assertions.evidence: nearest-rank p50=1ms, p95=2ms over 16 measured samples

assertions.name: the measured percentiles are asserted against the declared budget
assertions.evidence: declared budget: ABSENT — the repo declares no numeric live-path latency percentile budget (packages/slo SLOs.md scope = the W306 batch/frame pipeline; docs/deployment/DEPLOYMENT.md records measured live evidence "never a promise"). Measured: p50=1ms p95=2ms (n=16). Budget numbers are proposed to the TL as a docs amendment (see the gate REPORT); this line FAILS honestly until one is declared.

assertions.name: identity continuity is bounded (no unexplained re-identification across the window)
assertions.evidence: 24 entities over 16 frames; 0 identity switches; late appearances=0 (all with explicit entity-appeared events)

assertions.name: the reconnect-scenario session is selectable through the product's own live picker
assertions.evidence: picker answer="selected"

assertions.name: the dropout/reconnect scenario ran its gap (the stream's own recovery accounting arrived)
assertions.evidence: reconnect frames captured=41; recovery event: missedUpdates=8, gapDurationMs=800 (frame #40 of the captured window)

assertions.name: the interruption is EXPLICIT in the stream's own data (degraded quality carried, then recovered to nominal)
assertions.evidence: captured quality states={nominal,degraded}; quality-degraded/quality-nominal transition events=3 frames; nominal resumption after the recovery=observed

assertions.name: the dropout is VISIBLE in the product surface (the honest event ticker shows the accounted gap)
assertions.evidence: ticker row="source reconnect — 8 updates missed (0.8s gap, accounted)"

assertions.name: the degraded quality state was visible in the surface's own quality fact during the recovery window
assertions.evidence: quality-fact trajectory during the recovery window=[degraded → degraded → nominal] (the degraded window is 3 frames; the authoritative captured-state assert above carries this line if the poll cadence missed the transient chip)

assertions.name: the stream RECovers and continues (world versions advance past the recovery frame)
assertions.evidence: world version at recovery=v41; latest captured=v44; frames after recovery=3

assertions.name: the view does NOT change during a no-update window (the honest connecting state, never a fabricated one)
assertions.evidence: probe-verified pre-first-frame window: 1 samples (probe opens=1, first frame at sample #1); all connecting=1/1; fabricated-version samples=0; phases=live; staleness=awaiting-first-frame

assertions.name: the drop-scenario session is selectable through the product's own live picker
assertions.evidence: picker answer="selected"

assertions.name: the drop scenario's losses are counted sequence gaps (never smoothed over)
assertions.evidence: drop frames captured=14; source-sequence gaps=3 (first: 1 tick(s) after frame #3); dropRate default 0.15

assertions.name: the entity inspector pins the ball through the product's own picker
assertions.evidence: pick answer="pinned"

assertions.name: the pinned entity keeps its identity while its state updates (the inspector follows the ref, not a position)
assertions.evidence: pinned="ball-1 · BALL"; position x 84.12 · y 8.89 → x 73.64 · y 16.54; detection=detected

notes: signed in a fresh viewer account through the real register form (e2e-live-l015-musvmk3k)
hello: sessionId=sess-4 sourceKind=tactical cadenceMs=500 (the transport's own declaration)
the surface's own update-rate fact: "2.1 Hz"; frames fact: "16"
measured e2e latency (generation→receipt): n=16 p50=1ms p95=2ms max=2ms min=1ms; the surface's own displayed window: "1 / 2 / 2 ms"

the no-update negative control observed the verified pre-first-frame window (the probe wraps the page's own EventSource before the surface mounts — zero captured frames means zero delivered frames); the receipt-stall watchdog (2.5×cadence tolerance) is unit-proven in the root battery, and the L002 scenarios' own gaps (600ms/800ms/1000ms) are all sub-tolerance by design — they model bounded delivery anomalies, not outages

the drop scenario's browser-visible accounting: the picker's own description labels it ("Synthetic live tracking — scattered dropslive tactical view — the live view-model's world frames (L002 deterministic tracking source)tactical view-model"); the sequence-gap counts ride the captured frames (the surface's ordinal-drop counter is the transport-loss lane, a different seam)
